# White balance

Camera-style white balance: tell it the color temperature of the light and it neutralizes it (a Bradford adaptation in linear light), with a green–magenta tint.

<EffectDemo effect="white-balance" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { whiteBalance } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/white-balance';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(whiteBalance({ preset: 'tungsten' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.temperature = 6500`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter     | Type   | Default | Range          | Description                                                                                                           |
| ------------- | ------ | ------- | -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `temperature` | number | `6500`  | 2000 – 12000 K | The light the image is corrected for: lower values cool the image, higher values warm it. 6500 K leaves it unchanged. |
| `tint`        | number | `0`     | -1 – 1         | Positive is more magenta, negative more green.                                                                        |
| `amount`      | number | `1`     | 0 – 1          | Mix between the original and the balanced image.                                                                      |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset     | Settings                         |
| ---------- | -------------------------------- |
| `tungsten` | `temperature: 3200`              |
| `daylight` | `temperature: 5500`              |
| `cloudy`   | `temperature: 7500`              |
| `shade`    | `temperature: 9000`, `tint: 0.1` |

Apply one with `whiteBalance({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Color & tone · tracked as story X3.11 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 0.0 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 6.2 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/white-balance`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Bradford chromatic adaptation from a Planckian white point (Kim et al., 2002) to D65, using the xtree/color/white-balance chunk.
